rules.notes: Lark is Feishu for the rest of the world and the same editor underneath, down to the class names, so this mirrors feishu.cn.json. Checked against a tenant on jp.larksuite.com: the same .page-block-children body, the same .page-block-header h1, and the same watermark of invisible characters prefixed to document.title. The host is a suffix wildcard because a tenant sits under a region — qjpo13vakonb.jp.larksuite.com — so there are two labels below the domain, not one.
